title: Hearts: which three would you pass?
heading: Pass three
hookBottom:
In Hearts, you usually
want fewer points.
question:
Which three
would you pass?
context: Q♠ K♠ A♠ are your only spades.
questionBottom:
Look at the whole hand.
Choose before the reveal.
selectionBottom: No low spades to hide behind.
answerAccent:
So does the risk
of catching her
with K♠ or A♠.
answerBottom:
High hearts still need care.
Recheck after receiving cards.
caption: Q♠, K♠ and A♠ are your only spades. What would you pass? In this hand, passing all three removes the queen and the two cards that could catch her later. Recheck after receiving cards. Learn Hearts with Barbu, free on Google Play. #Hearts #CardGames #Barbu

title: Gin Rummy: which card would you discard?
heading: Keep your three combinations
hookBottom:
Keep complete sets and runs.
Unmatched cards add points.
question:
Which card
would you discard?
questionBottom:
Deadwood means the points
in your unmatched cards.
selectionContext: The king is outside every set and run.
selectionBottom: Keep the sevens and both runs.
answerBottom:
Three complete combinations.
Just 2 deadwood points.
caption: Which card would you discard? Keep the three sevens and both runs. In this Gin Rummy exercise, discarding K♠ leaves only 2♦ unmatched: two deadwood points. Learn by playing with Barbu, free on Google Play. #GinRummy #CardGames #Barbu

title: Gin Rummy: can you knock or go gin?
heading: Can you end the hand?
feedbackContains: you may knock, but not go gin
A knock is not a guaranteed win
hookBottom:
One unmatched card
can change your finish.
question:
Can you knock
or go gin?
questionBottom:
Only 2♦ is unmatched.
Which finish is available?
answerBottom:
Knocking is optional.
It does not guarantee a win.
caption: Can you knock or go gin? These ten cards have two deadwood points after the discard. In classic Gin Rummy you may knock with ten or fewer; gin requires zero. Continuing is legal too, and knocking does not guarantee a win. Learn with Barbu, free on Google Play. #GinRummy #CardGames #Barbu
